abstract: A 45 day old boy presented with progressive abdominal distension, tarry stools and anemia. A plain roentgenogram of the abdomen showed irregular, coarse calcifications in the left upper quadrant. The ultrasonography and computerized tomography of the abdomen revealed a large heterogeneous tumor with calcified parts in the left hemiabdomen. At operation, a 12 cm x 11 cm x 10 cm, multilobular, exogastric and endogastric tumor, including a portion of the anterior wall of the stomach, was extirpated. The pathological examination revealed a gastric teratoma with immature neural elements. Eight years after the total excision of the tumor there has not been any recurrence. This study includes a review of 88 cases (including the present case) of gastric teratoma reported in the English and Japanese literature.
abstract_ja: 45日齢の男児が、進行性の腹部膨満、タール便、貧血を呈した。腹部単純X線写真で左上腹部に不整で粗大な石灰化を認めた。超音波検査およびCTで、石灰化を伴う大きな不均一な腫瘍が左側腹腔内に認められた。手術では、胃前壁の一部を含む12×11×10 cmの多小葉性の腫瘍を、胃外性および胃内性に進展した状態で摘出した。病理検査で未熟な神経成分を伴う胃奇形腫と診断された。切除後8年を経て再発はない。本論文では英文および和文文献から報告された胃奇形腫88例（本症例を含む）のレビューも行う。
